name: Danny Eyre
education: B.S. in agricultural economics and business, Utah State University
prior_offices: Wyoming House District 19, 2017–2022; Uinta County School District No. 6 Board of Trustees (two terms, as listed in the 2021–22 legislative directory)
background: Danny Eyre of Lyman served in the Wyoming House from 2017 to 2022, representing House District 19. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born Feb. 2, 1948, in Rock Springs; listed a B.S. in agricultural economics and business from Utah State University; and identified him as retired from electric-utility management. It also recorded two terms on the Uinta County School District No. 6 Board of Trustees, and said he was married to his wife, Ann, and had six children and 21 grandchildren.
